capture_method: Plain HTTP against finance.yahoo.com public endpoints and server-rendered pages with a desktop browser user agent, using Yahoo's own documented anonymous crumb flow (fc.yahoo.com cookie + query*/v1/test/getcrumb) exactly as the live pages do: no login, no anti-bot bypass, no synthetic records. The quote snapshot is the v7 /finance/quote batch; per-symbol detail is v10 /quoteSummary (assetProfile, summaryDetail, defaultKeyStatistics, financialData, calendarEvents, incomeStatementHistory, summaryProfile); daily chart series is v8 /finance/chart; predefined screens are /v1/finance/screener/predefined/saved; the screener universe backbone is POST /v1/finance/screener per sector; trending is /v1/finance/trending/US; the earnings calendar is POST /v1/finance/visualization (entityIdType sp_earnings, the calendar page's own request); the news streams are the nexus-gateway-prod.media.yahoo.com GraphQL operation FinanceTopicArticleStream with the exact query and variables the live topic pages send (topic UUIDs captured from the live pages), plus the per-symbol news from query2.finance.yahoo.com/v1/finance/search; article bodies and metadata come from the finance.yahoo.com article HTML (JSON-LD NewsArticle block + server-rendered <article> paragraphs). Every request is archived raw with a .meta.json sidecar (URL, method, status, bytes, timestamp) under scraped_data/captures/ (gitignored). Sector/industry aggregates on the Sectors pages are computed from the captured per-symbol snapshot (documented derivation, no invented values).

finance.yahoo.com.role: primary site: market strip, quote pages (summary/statistics/financials/profile/history/news tabs), screener, earnings calendar, news hub, article pages, sectors
finance.yahoo.com.universe: 318 symbols: top-15 US listings per each of the 11 GICS sectors, all members of the six captured predefined screens, the major indices, futures, crypto pairs and ETFs

images.policy: every file fetched from the upstream URL it renders at (news thumbnails from Yahoo's s.yimg.com mysterio resizes and provider originals on media.zenfs.com); no placeholders, no duplicates, no stretching; verified with Pillow at download time

icons.note: static/icons/*.svg are original hand-drawn wordmark tiles describing the mirror (the u_s_customs/nyse precedent); all photographic media is upstream-fetched

benchmark_users.fixture: watchlist MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/SPY; alerts NVDA below 150, TSLA above 480
watchlist LLY/UNH/PFE; alerts LLY below 900, PFE above 30

fixtures.policy: authored fixtures following the u_s_customs / nyse / disney precedent: every symbol they reference is a real captured upstream quote; every timestamp is the frozen mirror date 2026-09-30 so the seed is byte-reproducible

mirror_semantics.deterministic_seed: instance_seed/yahoo_finance.db is rebuilt from source_data/*.json at image build time with PYTHONHASHSEED=0; two builds are byte-identical and the seed is hashseed-independent
mirror_semantics.earnings_week: Sunday-Saturday weeks, default week 2026-09-27..2026-10-03 (the upstream calendar's own convention), day tabs carry per-day counts, filters: symbol substring and BMO/AMC

rate_limit_note: All endpoints answered 200 across the capture (no 429s); the crumb was requested twice over the window and refreshed as the sessions rolled.
